Qualification blocker found while implementing the full JavaFX golden matrix. Frozen42369cf506fceaf4b6fec079fa28f36d6d94fcbe, Studio run40060539127: attempt1 rejects t2-Compare-light2x (64pixels,maxchannel34); identical-source controlled attempt2 rejects light2x (44pixels,max36) and dark2x (64pixels,max34). All30states execute, within-run repeats are stable, and the different patches lie at the same trial-caption boundary. Baseline collector and attempt1 share exact runner image20261012.322.1, JDK25.0.4.1, JavaFX24.0.1, fonts and software pipeline. A simple baseline replacement cannot represent both outputs reliably. Preserve maxchannel1/changedfraction0.001 and both negative attempts; no further blind full reruns.

Own a focused Linux reproduction, capture canvas/frame/clip bounds and isolate the clipping/scaling source. Add a meaningful regression/metamorphic case that fails before the correction, then qualify all30states/60PNGs on the corrected frozen tree. Recheck native output-scale2 and small-window functional coverage; report a provider defect upstream only if the cause is established. This slice blocks S10.4 final acceptance and will be batch-landed with the navigator/matrix implementation. Existing local canonical and Studio gates on42369cf5 passed, but neither this slice nor S10.4 is accepted/landed.
set.title: Stabilize trial-caption raster boundaries in transformed2x captures
